scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Quieter evidence-payoff beat after Memory Construct.

hard_outcomes: The ~500-year-old Yahtrean Westways recordbook contains a Wayfinder-derived copy.
The copy restores the Caelora-area center and shows a huge northern tower with routes continuing beyond the page.
The map does not name Cresthaven or Ivorybridge.
A later seal-reproduction workspace contains powerful magical attempts.
Its original Ancient purpose is unknown.
No successful duplicate Royal Magic Seal is proven.
The geographic lead becomes actionable while the seal lead remains unresolved.
knowledge_and_reveal_boundaries: No unsupported explanation of the royal-seal anomaly.
Do not identify the tower as Cresthaven until Beat 9.
Do not establish successful seal duplication.
Do not equate recent reader and seal practitioner without evidence.
